releases.name: With Eyes of Ice
releases.summary:
Dying of frostbite in the cold, unforgiving environs of Iceland, Greta Egilsdottir is left to wonder how, exactly, she found herself in such a dire situation.

Perhaps it began with Steina's baby, or with Kai agreeing to stay the night, or with that kiss she almost shared with Nataniel. Perhaps it began when she journeyed from her home of Reykjahlio to work as a housemaid in the distant fishing village of Myrakot...

Or perhaps it began three years ago, when her grandmother was still alive, and she lived in the small farming village of Reykjahlio.

That was when Gréeta first met him: the world-weary doctor with the fair hair, the tired eyes, and the intense, almost obsessive desire to help people.

For Greta, meeting Nataniel Johannsson was love at first sight... But there are some loves which cannot - or perhaps should not - be.

releases.name: iRacing Arcade
releases.summary:
iRacing Arcade is a third-person racer where your skills on and off the track shape your journey from grassroots racing to motorsport glory.

Compete in races to earn resources, then decide how to grow your team. Will you invest in buildings to unlock boosts that give you a crucial track advantage? Or will you focus on recruiting top-tier drivers to compete for you in licensed global series?

Every choice matters. Build your legacy, one race at a time!

releases.name: Psalm 5:9-13
releases.summary: "Psalm 5:9-13" is a first-person psychological horror game with VHS effect. Be careful and attentive, there is something hiding in these rooms, something is watching from the darkness.

releases.name: River Strike
releases.summary: Take control of legendary combat helicopters and battle your way upstream through enemy territory. Destroy bridges, warships, submarines, tanks and helicopters while completing 24 action-packed missions. Unlock new helicopters, upgrade their firepower and take on increasingly dangerous enemies in this modern low-poly tribute to the classic arcade shooters of the 80s and 90s.

releases.name: A Dark Room
releases.summary: awake. head throbbing. vision blurry.

releases.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
releases.summary:
The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! 

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

releases.name: Mortal Shell II
releases.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

releases.name: Gallipoli
releases.summary:
What began on mainland Europe, was never likely to end there... Prepare for relentless WW1 beach landings and desert warfare across the Middle Eastern Front in Gallipoli!

Faced with the deadlocked trenches of the Western Front, the Triple Entente looked for new pathways to victory. What was thought to be a quick expeditionary campaign to remove a German ally from the war, ended up in a disastrous four-year campaign: the Ottoman Empire wasn’t going down without a fight.

Gallipoli marks the fourth entry in the WW1 Game Series, further broadening its authentic and realistic FPS combat experience to give you the deepest dive into the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1 yet.

releases.name: The Witch's Bakery
releases.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

releases.name: Mexican Ninja
releases.summary: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

releases.name: Driving Is Hard
releases.summary:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard!

Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

releases.name: Ground Zero Hero
releases.summary:
Forget surviving the apocalypse. You’re here to dominate it.

Ground Zero Hero drops you into a radioactive wasteland overrun with mutated creatures. Every enemy you destroy becomes fuel for your evolution. Absorb their remains, stack mutations, and build increasingly powerful and unpredictable combinations until you become an unstoppable force.

Each run is a new experiment. Each build is a new monster.

Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, Ground Zero Hero blends bullet hell combat, roguelite progression, and survival mechanics into one addictive loop where every decision shapes your path to power.

ABSORB. MUTATE. EVOLVE.
Every enemy you defeat drops the raw material for your next transformation.
Stack mutations, combine abilities, and create wildly different builds every run.
No two playthroughs are ever the same.

SURVIVE OVERWHELMING HORDES
Face massive, screen-filling waves of mutated enemies attacking from all directions.
Each wave escalates. Each night gets deadlier.

Dodge, adapt, and push your build to its limits in pure bullet hell chaos.

LOOT, UPGRADE, DOMINATE
Collect resources from fallen enemies and crack safes under pressure to grow stronger.
Unlock and upgrade across multiple progression paths, each offering powerful bonuses that shape your playstyle.
Build smart. Survive longer. Become unstoppable.

releases.name: Grim Trials
releases.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

releases.name: Ninja Emaki
releases.summary:
An expansive ninja tale featuring 8 kinds of Ninja Magic and mysterious characters!

"NINJA EMAKI" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

releases.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Cost of Hope
releases.summary:
The fragile peace between Duty and Freedom stands on the brink of collapse. The heartlands of the Zone, forbidden for decades, now call to stalkers. New dangers - or perhaps wonders - begin to emerge.

Prepare to embark on a new expedition into the Zone in this massive nonlinear expansion, where dozens of hours of gameplay, unforgettable stories, and twisted characters await. A new chapter of the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. saga begins - shaped by your choices and actions in a journey you must survive, endure, and explore.

A chance to learn the Сost of Hope is upon us, stalkers.

releases.name: Birds Watching
releases.summary:
An endless global fire destroyed the world, and you are now alone, the last human being.

You survive on the top of a mountain, the only place still untouched by the flames, and your only occupation is watching with your binoculars the wild birds escaped up there with you.

It is a peaceful, isolated, desperate life.

Until you are not alone anymore, and the only ones who can save you are the birds; but they are picky. Satisfy them, or lose everything. Be honest. Be ruthless. Be careful.

Birds are watching.

releases.name: Berry Bury Berry
releases.summary:
Berry Bury Berry is a surreal first-person incremental game about growing berries and putting them in a hole. Lots and lots of berries.

Make and Upgrade Berry Buddies to grow higher and higher tiers of berries! Use all that sweet sweet money earned to unlock upgrades and tools to help increase profits and explore more of the accursed garden!

releases.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana - The Hippodrome
releases.summary:
Build the Hippodrome

Construct the Hippodrome, the biggest building in Latium. Unlocked with the Patricians, this monumental structure will test city planning and resource management like never before. Can you master all five stages of construction?

Host chariot races

With the Hippodrome comes an exclusive new event: chariot races! Gather resources and host thrilling races to satisfy your citizens' hunger for entertainment. The racetrack is where legends are made and ordinary specialists transform into unexpected heroes. Each success will grow your splendor, unlocking ever-grander competitions and providing wide-reaching effects to your city.

Train your specialists

Chariots need drivers, governor! Assign any specialist to the Hippodrome and watch them sharpen their skills with every race. The choice is yours: champion anyone, from the seasoned Roman veteran to the humble local baker.

releases.name: Dark Reflection
releases.summary: Dark reflection is a mix of good old-fashioned aesthetics of pixel games, black humor and light philosophy with cool and catchy music.

releases.name: Threshold Warden
releases.summary: Upgrade your tower, place turrets and traps, defeat zombies, and collect souls to strengthen your weapons and defenses. Protect the crystal and the border of worlds at all costs!

releases.name: Cyber Cycles
releases.summary:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

releases.name: Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess
releases.summary: Join Kururu on her journey to find true love and experience the charm of Rhapsody II's storybook adventure!

releases.name: No More Slimes!!
releases.summary:
The once peaceful Miallut Canyon has been overrun by a mysterious army of slimes. What started as a mere nuisance has now escalated into a massive commotion threatening the entire canyon.

You are the only fixer who can quell this chaos. Break through your limits as you hunt the endlessly swarming slimes, and join forces with unique mercenaries who have crossed dimensions.

Will you be able to find the true culprit behind the Slime Pandemonium and restore peace to the canyon?

releases.name: Nioh 3: Hell Rising
releases.summary: A new shadow of intrigue takes over future Edo in Hell Rising. Our protagonist and appointed shogun, Takechiyo, journeys through time and is led to Edo in the future by an unknown yokai he met in his dreams. There, following the death of the future Takechiyo, the era of peace has ended, and Edo has been retaken by the Crucible. With the cooperation of a one-eyed swordsman, Yagyu Jubei, and a Spanish envoy, Rodrigo, Takechiyo faces yet another plot revolving around Spirit Stones and an enemy with a strong resentment towards the shogunate.
